scientific_integrity: Formula and equality classification proved by resistance and arclength identities; exact rational checker corroborates 135 instances but cannot certify the universal theorem. Earlier resistance identities and abstract Sobolev embeddings are not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Real homogeneous mean-zero H^1 on finite two-hub bouquets joined by one positive-length bridge, with unweighted arclength measure. No result for arbitrary cactus graphs, nonuniform edge densities or vertex atoms, or nonlinear exponents. A comparable unindexed special-case graph inequality could limit originality.
title: Sharp Sobolev embedding and bridge-driven localization on double-bouquet metric graphs
